namespace_rules.action: Preserve while provenance is useful. Never merge solely because the branch is ahead. Before deletion, confirm no unique test/result referenced by an open decision issue.
Temporary/no-op provenance. Candidate for later cleanup only after ref/PR references are checked.

Historical convergence candidates, RED carriers and superseded fresh-main packets. Explicit admitted branches above override this rule. Do not merge old convergence branches after canonical admission.
Historical release/integration/ops carriers. Re-run deployment verification from current main; never merge an old release base to solve an external proof gap.
Historical team execution/proof branches. Semantic work was heavily reconstructed during convergence. Treat as source archaeology; fresh current-main regression is required before reviving anything.
Old frontend/secondary-flow packets. Frozen audit spot checks found representative lines already ancestral/admitted. Do not merge directly.

Legacy feature/fix/source branches. Explicit D5/P02/Hangouts exceptions above override this rule. Before deletion, use ancestry or semantic-current-main proof; do not treat branch name as an integration command.
Language-team historical/research branches. Explicit P01/P02 dispositions above override this rule.
Security candidate history. Explicit #265/#248 dispositions above override this rule.
Historical architecture/construction/reconciliation packets. Explicit construction-doc and ancestry dispositions above override this rule.

classification_notes.unknown_policy: This ledger intentionally has no automatic UNKNOWN catch-all. A branch not matched by an explicit entry or one of the recorded namespace rules must be treated as UNKNOWN and audited before any mutation.
classification_notes.deletion_policy: No branch is marked SAFE_DELETE in this ledger. Classification is complete enough to prevent blind merges; destructive branch cleanup remains a separate operation requiring ancestry/reference checks.
